notes.title: German Translation!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm happy to announce Robot Daycare finally got a new translation: The game can now be played in [b]German[/b]!

[b]Honey[/b], one of the original co-writers of the game, put a lot of work into this translation, so I hope you enjoy!

[h2]Update contents:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a German translation!
[*] Added the ability to access the text log during nvl mode.
[*] Added the ability to advance text by scrolling down.
[*] Added borders to the gallery images.
[*] Fixed image errors.
[/list]
I'm really glad Robot Daycare is still getting love years after it was made, thank you so much for your support!

If interested, check out the game I'm currently working on:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390800/Artificial_Selection_Demo

notes.title: Update 2.6
notes.content:
This update addresses recent feedback and improves blind accessibility:
[list]
[*] Fixed voices continuing to play in the game menu.
[*] Renamed the "Gore" setting to "Gore Descriptions".
[*] Renamed the "Voice Volume" setting to "Text Beep Volume".
[*] When assistive self-voicing is on, it will let you know when you have to enter text.
[*] The content warning doesn't automatically disappear the first time you start the game.
[*] Fixed typos.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 2.5
notes.content: This minor update fixes a bug when deleting the robot's name, and also makes the game less loud overall.

notes.title: Update 2.3 - Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
Minor improvements have been made, and Robot Daycare is now verified on Steam Deck!

The changes:
[list]
[*] Added Cloud Save support
[*] The input keyboard is automatically shown when naming the robot
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience, everyone. Robot Daycare is now available in Russian! 
I'm happy to bring this story to a whole new audience, and I hope you'll enjoy it!

This update also comes with a few minor improvements. Most notably, name initials were added to the NVL segments. Now it should be easier to tell which character is speaking.

Thanks for your continued support! If you want to discuss the game, why not join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S]Discord Server[/url]?

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894529/06e834521b600f42cf8bbc258ca6c262223288ed.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Robot Daycare in Russian?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, a huge thank you for all the support Robot Daycare has received over the past few months! 
I appreciate every single one of your reviews, and have also enjoyed watching various different streamers play the game. Some of your reactions are truly priceless, and the very reason why I make games in the first place. 

To share this game with as big of an audience as possible, I've been working with a translator who will allow me to publish this story in [b]Russian[/b]. A few minor improvements will also be included in that update. Look forward to it!

If you feel like pitching in, I would truly appreciate if you would [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/KigyoDev]buy me a brain cell[/url]. Every little bit helps!

[url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/KigyoDev][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894529/425248396ffec89a0a0cda754f5a76e1c68e8edb.png[/img][/url]

Again, thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: 2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I made some small improvements based on initial feedback:

[list]
[*] Turned down volume of the robot's startup sound
[*] The "Press Start" screen will only show up once
[*] Replaced rollback with calling the history screen
[*] Added Achievements button to main menu (after clearing the game once)
[*] Added Main Menu button to game menu (after clearing the game once)
[*] Removed duplicate entries in the text history
[/list]
Thank you for playing Robot Daycare!
